no_listings: No listings yet — add one above to start comparing.
turn_off_any_time: Turn your profile off any time to disappear from every match list instantly.
consent: I consent to my handle, area, budget, and preferences being shown to other opted-in students for roommate matching. No contact details are shared.
no_compatible: No compatible students yet — check back as more opt in for your area.

privacy_no_contact: We store no contact details and no exact address — just a handle, area, budget, and preferences.
privacy_compat_only: AgentBook shows compatibility only. It never messages anyone — you reach out through your school or housing group.
